part of 'int64_consumer_test.dart';

void verifyScalarResponses() {
  test('enum parameter lists remain independent and growable', () async {
    final transport = _ResponseTransport()..response = 'OPEN';
    final client = LuxoClient(transport);
    final states = [TaskStatusKnown.OPEN, TaskStatus.fromValue('FUTURE')];
    await client.enumOptions(nullable: null, nullableList: states);
    final raw = transport.params!['nullableList'] as List<String>;
    states[0] = TaskStatusKnown.DONE;
    expect(raw, ['OPEN', 'FUTURE']);
    raw.add('OTHER');
    expect(states.map((value) => value.rawValue), ['DONE', 'FUTURE']);
    await client.enumOptions(nullable: null, nullableList: []);
    final empty = transport.params!['nullableList'] as List<String>;
    empty.add('OPEN');
    expect(empty, ['OPEN']);
  });
  test(
    'enum parameters preserve omitted values, null and raw unknown text',
    () async {
      final transport = _ResponseTransport()..response = 'FUTURE';
      final client = LuxoClient(transport);
      await client.enumOptions(nullable: null, nullableList: null);
      expect(transport.params, {'nullable': null, 'nullableList': null});
      final unknown = TaskStatus.fromValue('FUTURE');
      await client.enumOptions(
        nullable: unknown,
        nullableList: [unknown],
        defaulted: unknown,
        nullableDefault: sdk.LuxoOptional.present(unknown),
      );
      expect(transport.params, {
        'nullable': 'FUTURE',
        'nullableList': ['FUTURE'],
        'defaulted': 'FUTURE',
        'nullableDefault': 'FUTURE',
      });
      await client.enumOptions(
        nullable: null,
        nullableList: [],
        nullableDefault: const sdk.LuxoOptional<TaskStatus>.present(null),
      );
      expect(transport.params, {
        'nullable': null,
        'nullableList': [],
        'nullableDefault': null,
      });
      for (final invalid in [null, 1, true, <Object?>{}]) {
        expect(
          () => EnumPayload.fromJson({'status': invalid}),
          throwsA(isA<TypeError>()),
        );
        expect(
          () => EnumPayload.fromJson({
            'statuses': ['OPEN', invalid],
          }),
          throwsA(isA<TypeError>()),
        );
      }
    },
  );

  test(
    'enum models preserve unknown values, null and selection in both encodings',
    () {
      for (final nullable in [false, true]) {
        final json = <String, Object?>{
          'status': '未来状态',
          'optional': nullable ? null : 'FUTURE',
          'statuses': ['OPEN', 'FUTURE'],
          'optionalList': nullable ? null : ['DONE', 'FUTURE'],
        };
        final input = EnumPayloadInput.fromJson(json);
        expect(input.status, isA<TaskStatusUnknown>());
        expect(input.toJson(), json);
        expect(input.toLuxoParameters(), json);
        final row = sdk.LuxoEncoder();
        input.writeLuxo(row);
        expect(
          row.bytes().first,
          utf8.encode('未来状态').length + (nullable ? 0 : 6),
        );
        expect(decodeEnumPayload(sdk.LuxoDecoder(row.bytes())).toJson(), json);
        final model = EnumPayload.fromJson(json);
        expect(model.status.value.rawValue, '未来状态');
        expect(model.toJson(), json);
        expect(EnumPayload.fromJson({}).status.isSelected, isFalse);
        expect(EnumPayload.fromJson({'optional': null}).optional.value, isNull);
        final column = sdk.LuxoEncoder()
          ..writeVarint(1)
          ..writeVarint(0);
        column
          ..writeVarint(1)
          ..writeString('未来状态')
          ..writeVarint(2);
        if (nullable) {
          column.writeNull();
        } else {
          column
            ..writePresent()
            ..writeString('FUTURE');
        }
        final list =
            (sdk.LuxoEncoder()
                  ..writeVarint(2)
                  ..writeString('OPEN')
                  ..writeString('FUTURE'))
                .bytes();
        column
          ..writeVarint(3)
          ..writeBytes(list)
          ..writeVarint(4);
        if (nullable) {
          column.writeNull();
        } else {
          column
            ..writePresent()
            ..writeBytes(
              (sdk.LuxoEncoder()
                    ..writeVarint(2)
                    ..writeString('DONE')
                    ..writeString('FUTURE'))
                  .bytes(),
            );
        }
        column.writeEnd();
        expect(decodeColumnarEnumPayload(column.bytes()).single.toJson(), json);
        column
          ..writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(1))
          ..writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(1))
          ..writeSvarint(sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(1));
        expect(
          decodePaginatedEnumPayload(column.bytes()).items.single.toJson(),
          json,
        );
      }
      expect(
        TaskStatus.fromValue('future'),
        isNot(OtherStatus.fromValue('future')),
      );
      expect({
        TaskStatus.fromValue('future'),
        TaskStatus.fromValue('future'),
      }, hasLength(1));
      expect(OtherStatusKnown.class$.rawValue, 'class');
      expect(OtherStatusKnown.values$.rawValue, 'values');
      expect(OtherStatusKnown.rawValue$.rawValue, 'rawValue');
      expect(OtherStatusKnown.value$_hidden.rawValue, '_hidden');
      expect(OtherStatusKnown.OtherStatusKnown$.rawValue, 'OtherStatusKnown');
      expect(
        () => sdk.encodeLuxoJSON(TaskStatus.fromValue('future')),
        throwsFormatException,
      );
    },
  );

  test(
    'named enum returns use scalar wire decoding without field selection',
    () async {
      final transport = _ResponseTransport();
      final client = LuxoClient(transport);
      for (final text in ['OPEN', 'DONE', 'FUTURE', '', '未来状态']) {
        final expected = TaskStatus.fromValue(text);
        transport.response = text;
        expect(await client.namedEnum(), expected);
        transport.response = (sdk.LuxoEncoder()..writeString(text)).bytes();
        expect(await client.namedEnum(), expected);
        expect(transport.params, isEmpty);
        transport.response = [text];
        expect(await client.namedEnums(), [expected]);
        transport.response =
            (sdk.LuxoEncoder()
                  ..writeVarint(1)
                  ..writeString(text))
                .bytes();
        expect(await client.namedEnums(), [expected]);
        expect(transport.params, isEmpty);
        expect(expected.rawValue, text);
        if (text == 'OPEN' || text == 'DONE') {
          expect(expected, isA<TaskStatusKnown>());
          expect(identical(TaskStatus.fromValue(text), expected), isTrue);
        } else {
          expect(expected, isA<TaskStatusUnknown>());
          expect(_describeStatus(expected), text);
        }
        transport.response = text;
        await client.echoEnum(value: expected);
        expect(transport.params?['value'], text);
      }
      for (final bytes in <List<int>>[
        [],
        [1],
        [1, 255],
        [0, 99],
      ]) {
        transport.response = Uint8List.fromList(bytes);
        await expectLater(client.namedEnum(), throwsFormatException);
        await expectLater(client.namedEnums(), throwsFormatException);
      }
    },
  );

  test('implicit Int returns retain scalar and list shape', () async {
    final transport = _ResponseTransport();
    final client = LuxoClient(transport);
    for (final value in [sdk.LuxoInt64.minValue, sdk.LuxoInt64.maxValue]) {
      transport.response = value.toBigInt();
      expect(await client.implicitInteger(), value);
      transport.response = (sdk.LuxoEncoder()..writeSvarint(value)).bytes();
      expect(await client.implicitInteger(), value);
      transport.response = [value.toBigInt()];
      expect(await client.implicitIntegers(), [value]);
      transport.response =
          (sdk.LuxoEncoder()
                ..writeVarint(1)
                ..writeSvarint(value))
              .bytes();
      expect(await client.implicitIntegers(), [value]);
    }
  });

  test('generated scalar and scalar-list streams reject bad payloads before callback delivery', () async {
    final transport = _ResponseTransport();
    final client = LuxoClient(transport);
    final unary = _streamSubscribers(client, array: false);
    final arrays = _streamSubscribers(client, array: true);
    final cells = _scalarArrayCells();
    for (var index = 0; index < unary.length; index++) {
      final position = index == 11 ? 9 : index;
      final values = _streamValues[position];
      final expected = position == 9
          ? values
                .map((value) => TaskStatus.fromValue(value as String))
                .toList()
          : values;
      final cell = cells[position];
      final element = Uint8List.sublistView(
        cell,
        1,
        _firstElementEnd(position),
      );
      final malformed = _malformedScalarPayloads(position);
      await _verifySubscription(
        transport,
        unary[index],
        element,
        expected.first,
        _jsonValue(values.first),
        malformed,
      );
      await _verifySubscription(
        transport,
        arrays[index],
        cell,
        expected,
        values.map(_jsonValue).toList(),
        [
          for (final bytes in malformed) ...[
            [1, ...bytes],
            [2, ...element, ...bytes],
          ],
        ],
      );
    }
  });
}

String _describeStatus(TaskStatus status) => switch (status) {
  TaskStatusKnown.OPEN => 'open',
  TaskStatusKnown.DONE => 'done',
  TaskStatusUnknown(:final rawValue) => rawValue,
};

typedef _Subscribe = Future<void Function()> Function(void Function(Object));

List<_Subscribe> _streamSubscribers(LuxoClient c, {required bool array}) =>
    array
    ? [
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchIntArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchDurationArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchFloatArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchStringArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchBooleanArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchDateTimeArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchUUIDArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchBytesArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchDecimalArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchEnumArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchJSONArray(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchTaskStatusArray(onData: receive),
      ]
    : [
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchInt(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchDuration(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchFloat(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchString(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchBoolean(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchDateTime(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchUUID(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchBytes(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchDecimal(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchEnum(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchJSON(onData: receive),
        (receive) => c.subscribeWatchTaskStatus(onData: receive),
      ];

// Offsets in the independently written two-element wire fixtures, including count.
int _firstElementEnd(int kind) => switch (kind) {
  0 || 1 => 11,
  2 => 9,
  3 || 4 || 7 => 2,
  5 => 3,
  6 => 17,
  8 => 3,
  9 => 6,
  10 => 7,
  _ => throw StateError('unknown fixture kind'),
};

List<List<Object>> get _streamValues => [
  [sdk.LuxoInt64.minValue, sdk.LuxoInt64.maxValue],
  [sdk.LuxoInt64.minValue, sdk.LuxoInt64.maxValue],
  [1.5, 2.0],
  ['', '\uFEFF\uFEFF发布\uFFFD'],
  [false, true],
  ['1970-01-01T00:00:00Z', '1970-01-01T00:00:01Z'],
  [_uuid, _uuid],
  [
    Uint8List(0),
    Uint8List.fromList([1, 255]),
  ],
  ['0', '1.25'],
  ['OPEN', 'DONE'],
  [
    false,
    {'large': BigInt.parse('18446744073709551616')},
  ],
];

Object _jsonValue(Object value) => switch (value) {
  sdk.LuxoInt64() => value.toBigInt(),
  Uint8List() => base64Encode(value),
  _ => value,
};

List<List<int>> _malformedScalarPayloads(int kind) {
  final overflow = [...List<int>.filled(9, 255), 2];
  return switch (kind) {
    0 || 1 || 5 => [overflow],
    3 || 8 || 9 => [
      [1, 255],
      overflow,
    ],
    4 => [
      [2],
    ],
    7 => [overflow],
    10 => [
      [1, 123],
      [1, 255],
      overflow,
    ],
    _ => [],
  };
}

Future<void> _verifySubscription(
  _ResponseTransport transport,
  _Subscribe subscribe,
  Uint8List bytes,
  Object expected,
  Object json,
  List<List<int>> malformed,
) async {
  final delivered = <Object>[];
  final stop = await subscribe(delivered.add);
  expect(transport.params, isEmpty);
  transport.emit(bytes);
  expect(delivered, [expected]);
  for (var end = 0; end < bytes.length; end++) {
    expect(
      () => transport.emit(Uint8List.sublistView(bytes, 0, end)),
      throwsFormatException,
    );
    expect(delivered, [expected]);
  }
  expect(
    () => transport.emit(Uint8List.fromList([...bytes, 99])),
    throwsFormatException,
  );
  expect(delivered, [expected]);
  for (final value in malformed) {
    expect(
      () => transport.emit(Uint8List.fromList(value)),
      throwsFormatException,
    );
    expect(delivered, [expected]);
  }
  delivered.clear();
  transport.emit(json);
  expect(delivered, [expected]);
  stop();
  expect(transport.receiver, isNull);
}

// Controlled response injection tests generated callbacks, not real WebSocket frames.
class _ResponseTransport extends sdk.Transport {
  Object? response;
  Map<String, dynamic>? params;
  void Function(dynamic)? receiver;

  @override
  Future<T> call<T>(
    String api, {
    Map<String, dynamic>? params,
    sdk.GeneratedRequest? request,
    T Function(dynamic)? decoder,
  }) async {
    this.params = request?.toJSONParameters() ?? params;
    return decoder!(response);
  }

  @override
  Future<void Function()> subscribe<T>(
    String api,
    Map<String, dynamic> params,
    void Function(T) onData, {
    required T Function(Object?) decoder,
    sdk.GeneratedRequest? request,
    void Function(sdk.LuxoError)? onError,
    void Function()? onDone,
  }) async {
    this.params = request?.toJSONParameters() ?? params;
    receiver = (value) => onData(decoder(value));
    return () => receiver = null;
  }

  void emit(Object? value) => receiver!(value);
  @override
  void setSchema(Map<String, sdk.APISchemaEntry> schema) {}
  @override
  void setMode(sdk.TransportMode mode) {}
  @override
  void setToken(String token) {}
  @override
  void close() {
    receiver = null;
  }
}
